## PowerShell

Where is the reference for this cmdlet, module, or practice?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PowerShell Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's documentation hub for PowerShell: installing on Windows, Linux, and macOS, sample scripts, the module browser, Desired State Configuration, and the PowerShell Gallery. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [PowerShell Gallery](https://www.powershellgallery.com/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's public repository of PowerShell scripts, modules, and DSC resources; the site warns that its packages come from the community and are untrusted by default. | Online service | Free |
| [PowerShell (GitHub repository)](https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell) | PowerShell Team (Microsoft) | Source repository for PowerShell 7, with a pointer to installation instructions, an explanation of how it differs from Windows PowerShell, and community discussions. | Tool | Free |
| [PowerShell Team blog](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/powershell/) | Microsoft | The PowerShell team's blog at Microsoft: release announcements for PowerShell and Desired State Configuration, and posts on the roadmap. | News | Free |
| [Pester](https://pester.dev/) | Pester Team | Site of Pester, the testing and mocking framework for PowerShell, with a quick start and a follow-along tutorial. | Tool | Free |
| [PSScriptAnalyzer](https://github.com/PowerShell/PSScriptAnalyzer) | PowerShell Team (Microsoft) | Checks PowerShell scripts and modules against a set of rules for code quality; installed from the PowerShell Gallery. | Tool | Free |
| [PowerShell 101](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/learn/ps101/00-introduction) | Microsoft | A book for learning PowerShell, hosted on Microsoft Learn: chapters that each end with links to the help articles that go deeper. | Training or lab | Free |
| [PowerShell Practice and Style](https://poshcode.gitbook.io/powershell-practice-and-style) | PoshCode | Community-written guide to PowerShell in two parts, a style guide and best practices, free to share and adapt under a Creative Commons license. *Last updated on May 19, 2023.* | Reference | Free |
| [Microsoft Desired State Configuration overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/dsc/overview) | Microsoft | Microsoft's overview of Desired State Configuration, its declarative configuration platform for Windows, Linux, and macOS: configuration documents, resources, and how it differs from PowerShell DSC. | Vendor documentation | Free |
